variant: Existing illustration scenes with short English headings
scope: Companion illustrations; original images, guide text, tables, external source requirements and placement statuses are unchanged.
text_note: PNG headings are rasterised; heading copy is retained as editable strings here for translation and future production.

assets.title: Sharing Open Educational Materials
assets.purpose: Show open educational materials being shared while keeping written licence terms in the guide.
assets.alt: An educator hands a course guide to an older learner, with a second copy and his notes nearby. Heading: “Sharing Open Educational Materials”.

assets.title: Thinking through a Claim
assets.purpose: Show learners examining evidence and considering alternatives.
assets.alt: the beginner learner and the older learner thoughtfully compare two plain pictorial evidence cards with different object examples on a small desk. Heading: “Thinking through a Claim”.

assets.title: Connected Course Learning
assets.purpose: Show shared learning connected to practical and community work.
assets.alt: the educator and the beginner learner consult an open course guide at a table while the business owner brings a simple practice phone and small produce basket to the same table, connecting classroom learning with local use. Heading: “Connected Course Learning”.

assets.title: Learning Pathway
assets.purpose: Illustrate progression from studying to practical application.
assets.alt: Three small equal story scenes featuring the SAME the beginner learner: reading an open guide; carefully practising with a phone facing him; explaining a simple goods exchange using rice and shoes on a table. Heading: “Learning Pathway”.

assets.title: Four Learning Contexts
assets.purpose: Illustrate the four-module course subjects alongside the retained module table.
assets.alt: One purposeful tabletop gathering: the older learner considers everyday money represented by blank banknotes; the technical learner studies a small network drawing; the business owner handles a training phone; the educator connects their examples using an open guide. Heading: “Four Learning Contexts”.

assets.title: Learn Practise Explain
assets.purpose: Show a learner moving from explanation through practice to explaining independently.
assets.alt: An educator demonstrates arranging everyday goods cards, guides a learner through practice, then listens to his explanation. Heading: “Learn Practise Explain”.

assets.title: Examining the Properties of Money
assets.purpose: Illustrate inquiry into qualities that make money useful.
assets.alt: the beginner learner and the technical learner examine a few plain tokens, a divided rectangular tile, a small carrying pouch and a durable metal-like gray object on a desk. Heading: “Examining the Properties of Money”.

assets.title: Money in Everyday Use
assets.purpose: Show money serving exchange and keeping a record of value.
assets.alt: the business owner hands a small grocery bag to the older learner across a simple counter as he offers a few plain cool-gray unmarked banknotes; her open notebook and a small closed saving envelope sit nearby. Heading: “Money in Everyday Use”.

assets.title: Barter Mismatch
assets.purpose: Make incompatible direct-exchange wants visible.
assets.alt: Three people offer rice, shoes and cooking oil while pictorial callouts show different wants and broken arrows show exchanges failing. Heading: “Barter Mismatch”.

assets.title: Money-mediated Exchange
assets.purpose: Show a person selling to one party and buying from another using a common medium.
assets.alt: In two consecutive scenes the same woman sells rice to a man for plain tokens, then uses the tokens to buy shoes from a different man. Heading: “Money-mediated Exchange”.

assets.title: Water and Context
assets.purpose: Show how context changes the usefulness of the same bottle of water.
assets.alt: The same water bottle appears in a well-stocked shop refrigerator and beside a thirsty adult in a sparse hot setting. Heading: “Water and Context”.

assets.title: Choosing Among Goods
assets.purpose: Show a learner weighing everyday alternatives without prescribing a correct choice.
assets.alt: A thoughtful shopper in a white hoodie considers a notebook, shoes and a cooking pot on a simple store shelf. Heading: “Choosing Among Goods”.

assets.title: Forms of Money through History
assets.purpose: Provide a pictorial sequence accompanying the guide's historical explanation.
assets.alt: A sequence of direct exchange, commodity goods, coins, representative paper, institutional money and digital devices. Heading: “Forms of Money through History”.

assets.title: Participants in a Fiat System
assets.purpose: Illustrate people and institutions with distinct roles in a money system.
assets.alt: the educator explains a tabletop set of distinct simple architectural models: one central-bank-like institutional building, one commercial-bank branch, one civic building and a small shop model. Heading: “Participants in a Fiat System”.

assets.title: Fiat Payment Relationships
assets.purpose: Show a bank-mediated everyday payment as the subject of the system map.
assets.alt: the older learner and the business owner make an ordinary cash-deposit inquiry at a generic bank counter with blank deposit slip and closed notebook. Heading: “Fiat Payment Relationships”.

assets.title: Borrowing and Repayment
assets.purpose: Illustrate a borrower reviewing a bank loan and repayment obligations.
assets.alt: A business owner and educator discuss a pictorial loan document beside a bank model and repayment calendar. Heading: “Borrowing and Repayment”.

assets.title: Liquidity and Solvency Situations
assets.purpose: Provide contrasting scenes for liquidity and solvency risk.
assets.alt: Balanced side-by-side scenes: left the beginner learner and the older learner wait calmly beside a generic bank branch with a cash-withdrawal slot and small closed shutter; right the business owner studies a house model and an unlettered payment notice with a small orange caution triangle. Heading: “Liquidity and Solvency Situations”.

assets.title: Changing Purchasing Power
assets.purpose: Show less purchasing power for the same amount of money.
assets.alt: Comparison pair repeats the business owner and the EXACT SAME three plain cool-gray unmarked banknotes laid on counter. Heading: “Changing Purchasing Power”.

assets.title: Comparing Forms of Money
assets.purpose: Illustrate comparison of physical and digital money without collapsing their attributes.
assets.alt: the older learner holds a plain unmarked banknote while the technical learner compares two generic phones and a small network demonstration on the desk. Heading: “Comparing Forms of Money”.

assets.title: Considering Asset Trade-offs
assets.purpose: Illustrate a person weighing different ways to hold value.
assets.alt: the older learner thoughtfully considers three equally sized unlettered cards on desk showing house, plain metal ingot and company share certificate with no text. Heading: “Considering Asset Trade-offs”.

assets.title: Three Alternative Assets
assets.purpose: Show three examples of assets without ranking or investment recommendation.
assets.alt: Three equally weighted illustrations show a house with a key handover, an unlabelled stock chart and a simple ingot. Heading: “Three Alternative Assets”.

assets.title: Transaction through Shared Ledger
assets.purpose: Show two people communicating a payment through distributed verification.
assets.alt: A sender and receiver use phones on opposite sides of several connected computers, each displaying the same pictorial ledger. Heading: “Transaction through Shared Ledger”.

assets.title: Ideas Combining Over Time
assets.purpose: Show different technical ideas being compared and combined.
assets.alt: the educator and the technical learner at desk arrange three pictorial research sheets: key and lock, generic digital-payment device, equal peer-network dots. Heading: “Ideas Combining Over Time”.

assets.title: Checking a Conflicting Spend
assets.purpose: Illustrate independent checking of conflicting payment instructions.
assets.alt: A learner presents conflicting pictorial payment instructions while another checks them, with one conflicting instruction marked with a cross. Heading: “Checking a Conflicting Spend”.

assets.title: Studying Bitcoin's Early History
assets.purpose: Illustrate historical milestones without replacing dates or source detail.
assets.alt: the older learner reads a plain whitepaper-style document beside a modest small pizza box and a simple page showing a linked sequence of flat record rectangles. Heading: “Studying Bitcoin's Early History”.

assets.title: Distributed Participant Roles
assets.purpose: Show people and equipment contributing different roles without a controller.
assets.alt: Three adults discuss distinct user, node and mining roles with separate devices and flat ledger-record illustrations. Heading: “Distributed Participant Roles”.

assets.title: Checking a Supply Claim
assets.purpose: Show verification rather than trusting an issuer's claim alone.
assets.alt: Two learners compare a pictorial supply claim with checks performed by several independent computers. Heading: “Checking a Supply Claim”.

assets.title: Learning About Issuance
assets.purpose: Illustrate learning about a capped issuance schedule without a price forecast.
assets.alt: An educator and learner discuss a diminishing subsidy staircase and a cumulative issuance curve approaching a ceiling. Heading: “Learning About Issuance”.

assets.title: Understanding Divisibility
assets.purpose: Make the idea of dividing one unit into smaller parts concrete.
assets.alt: the older learner actively rearranges a flat purple rectangular tile divided into many matching equal squares, showing one whole and smaller pieces beside it. Heading: “Understanding Divisibility”.

assets.title: Peer-to-peer Communication
assets.purpose: Show a route between two peers without a central approving authority.
assets.alt: Two peers with phones stand on opposite sides of an evenly connected network, with one path highlighted between them. Heading: “Peer-to-peer Communication”.

assets.title: Four Bitcoin Roles
assets.purpose: Illustrate users, nodes, miners and developers as distinct roles.
assets.alt: Four equally weighted square vignettes with no titles: the beginner learner uses phone; a small independent server/node computer; a compact mining hardware unit; the technical learner writes software at laptop facing him. Heading: “Four Bitcoin Roles”.

assets.title: Mining and Independent Checks
assets.purpose: Show mining equipment and independent node verification as separate actions.
assets.alt: the technical learner indicates a compact mining-hardware box beside a candidate record sheet; the older learner independently examines that record on a different node computer with a simple check cue. Heading: “Mining and Independent Checks”.

assets.title: Seven Monetary Properties
assets.purpose: Support the guide's seven-property reference with distinct pictorial cues.
assets.alt: Seven linked pictorial cues represent durability, portability, divisibility, interchangeability, scarcity, verification and acceptance. Heading: “Seven Monetary Properties”.

assets.title: Benefits and Responsibilities
assets.purpose: Illustrate weighing Bitcoin's usefulness against personal responsibilities.
assets.alt: the beginner learner compares an everyday payment situation shown on an object card while the older learner examines a key and a sealed backup envelope on the same table. Heading: “Benefits and Responsibilities”.

assets.title: Wallet Controls Keys
assets.purpose: Show a wallet managing keys and sending instructions to a separately held ledger.
assets.alt: A learner uses a phone with a key symbol; an instruction travels to a separate network of public-ledger computers. Heading: “Wallet Controls Keys”.

assets.title: Checking Public Receiving Information
assets.purpose: Illustrate checking public receiving information before a payment.
assets.alt: Two learners check a tablet and a pictorial receiving-information card; the tablet screen faces them. Heading: “Checking Public Receiving Information”.

assets.title: Keeping Private Keys Private
assets.purpose: Contrast shareable receiving information with secret key control.
assets.alt: the technical learner keeps a physical teaching key in a small closed personal box on his side of desk while holding outward a separate public-contact-style card containing only an abstract receiving arrow. Heading: “Keeping Private Keys Private”.

assets.title: Private Wallet Recovery
assets.purpose: Make offline private backup and compatible recovery concrete.
assets.alt: the older learner alone at a quiet desk carefully takes a plain backup card from a closed envelope beside his own phone and hardware device, their screens face him. Heading: “Private Wallet Recovery”.

assets.title: Who Controls the Keys
assets.purpose: Contrast user key control and remote service key control without ranking safety.
assets.alt: Two equally weighted scenes show a person with a key beside their phone and a person whose phone connects to a remote server holding the key. Heading: “Who Controls the Keys”.

assets.title: Comparing Custody Responsibilities
assets.purpose: Illustrate asking who controls keys and handles recovery.
assets.alt: the educator and the business owner compare two equally weighted tabletop teaching arrangements: phone with a key next to its user side; similar phone connected by a thin straight path to a remote rectangular server containing a key symbol. Heading: “Comparing Custody Responsibilities”.

assets.title: Different Wallet Arrangements
assets.purpose: Illustrate comparing connectivity and key control separately.
assets.alt: the older learner and the technical learner examine a phone, a small hardware signing device, a key and a remote-server model arranged as distinct props. Heading: “Different Wallet Arrangements”.

assets.title: Connected and Offline Signing Devices
assets.purpose: Illustrate connectivity while leaving custody distinctions to adjacent guide text.
assets.alt: A phone with a connectivity symbol is paired with a dedicated hardware device whose connectivity symbol is crossed out. Heading: “Connected and Offline Signing Devices”.

assets.title: Safe Recovery Rehearsal
assets.purpose: Illustrate private recovery rehearsal using prepared training material.
assets.alt: the technical learner alone at a desk using an empty training phone and a closed backup envelope, with pictorial instruction guide beside him. Heading: “Safe Recovery Rehearsal”.

assets.title: Receiving Notification
assets.purpose: Make the receiver role concrete without depicting payable details.
assets.alt: The business owner smiles calmly at a phone displaying a pictorial incoming arrow and check mark. Heading: “Receiving Notification”.

assets.title: Check Before Sending
assets.purpose: Reinforce reviewing checks before approving a payment.
assets.alt: The older learner examines a phone showing pictorial checks for recipient, destination and amount before approving anything. Heading: “Check Before Sending”.

assets.title: Understanding Confirmations
assets.purpose: Illustrate learning that transaction inclusion gains depth as records follow.
assets.alt: the educator and the older learner study a simple classroom display containing a flat transaction-document card beside a horizontal sequence of five connected flat record rectangles; the second rectangle contains a small matching document motif and later rectangles extend beyond it. Heading: “Understanding Confirmations”.

assets.title: Pausing at a Scam Signal
assets.purpose: Make stopping to verify a suspicious message memorable.
assets.alt: the business owner holds phone facing herself and raises her free hand in a calm stop gesture; beside phone a small orange triangular flag on a straight pole and an unlettered generic message card with a warning mark. Heading: “Pausing at a Scam Signal”.

assets.title: Three Acquisition Routes
assets.purpose: Show earning, peer exchange and a generic computer-based exchange as distinct routes.
assets.alt: Three scenes show work rewarded through a phone payment, cash exchanged between peers and a learner using a computer-based exchange. Heading: “Three Acquisition Routes”.

assets.title: Examining an Exchange Route
assets.purpose: Show learners checking an exchange route beyond its headline price.
assets.alt: the older learner and the business owner compare two simple route cards on desk; each card shows generic cash-to-phone handover with small separate pictorial cues for a clock, key and identity card. Heading: “Examining an Exchange Route”.

assets.title: Bitcoin and Lightning Relationship
assets.purpose: Illustrate discussing two related payment layers without presenting two coins.
assets.alt: the educator explains a simple layer-stack teaching board to the beginner learner: lower broad purple band bears ONE orange ₿ symbol, upper thin path bears a Lightning bolt and connects two simple endpoint dots; the upper path is visibly anchored to the lower band. Heading: “Bitcoin and Lightning Relationship”.

assets.title: Comparing Payment Paths
assets.purpose: Illustrate a neutral comparison of on-chain and Lightning payment paths.
assets.alt: the business owner and the technical learner compare two unlettered pictorial payment-path cards beside their own phones, one card bearing a flat ledger page, other a Lightning bolt; a small clock and a key sit separately on table to prompt timing/custody questions. Heading: “Comparing Payment Paths”.

assets.title: Responsibilities Around Keys
assets.purpose: Show key control accompanied by practical responsibilities.
assets.alt: the older learner alone carefully organizes key, closed backup envelope, generic phone, plain instruction guide and small pictorial checklist on desk. Heading: “Responsibilities Around Keys”.

assets.title: Reviewing Practical Responsibilities
assets.purpose: Illustrate reviewing what must be protected and checked before use.
assets.alt: the educator listens as the business owner points with pen to a pictorial checklist beside a phone, closed backup envelope and key on a simple desk. Heading: “Reviewing Practical Responsibilities”.

assets.title: Local Learning with Purpose
assets.purpose: Illustrate connecting a local need to comparison and safe practice.
assets.alt: the business owner explains a practical merchant need using a small goods basket; the technical learner offers two pictorial alternatives on cards; the educator supports discussion beside an empty training phone and open guide. Heading: “Local Learning with Purpose”.

assets.title: Community Conversation
assets.purpose: Show voluntary community discussion about Bitcoin.
assets.alt: Four adults discuss a simple Bitcoin learning card together, with two phones resting nearby. Heading: “Community Conversation”.

assets.title: Presentation Practice Production
assets.purpose: Show demonstration, guided practice and independent performance.
assets.alt: Three equal story panels: the educator demonstrates arranging blank training cards to the beginner learner; the beginner learner practises arranging cards with the educator pointing only to instruction guide; the beginner learner independently completes arrangement and explains while the educator listens from a respectful distance. Heading: “Presentation Practice Production”.

assets.title: Evaluating a Local Tool
assets.purpose: Illustrate checking source custody compatibility and support before tool use.
assets.alt: the business owner and the technical learner carefully compare two unbranded device examples, an open pictorial instruction guide, a key-control prop and a plain support contact card. Heading: “Evaluating a Local Tool”.

assets.title: Recording a Tool Review
assets.purpose: Show recording checks and remaining uncertainties about a tool.
assets.alt: the older learner writes with a pen in a simple pictorial review notebook beside his generic phone, a small blank calendar card and an alternative hardware device. Heading: “Recording a Tool Review”.

assets.title: Reviewing a Lightning Request
assets.purpose: Illustrate checking a Lightning request before approving it.
assets.alt: the business owner holds a phone facing herself while the beginner learner carefully reviews his own phone at a simple counter, pausing before tapping. Heading: “Reviewing a Lightning Request”.

assets.title: Everyday Uses
assets.purpose: Illustrate several voluntary everyday uses of Bitcoin.
assets.alt: A calm market-counter scene: the business owner records a purchase in a plain notebook, the older learner receives a goods bag and keeps his own phone; at one corner a closed saving envelope and at the other a modest donated textbook sit as supporting props. Heading: “Everyday Uses”.

assets.title: Coffee Purchase
assets.purpose: Connect a phone payment with an ordinary merchant exchange.
assets.alt: A server hands a cup of coffee to a customer while both check their own phones at a simple counter. Heading: “Coffee Purchase”.

assets.title: Generic Bitcoin ATM
assets.purpose: Illustrate an ATM as one possible exchange route.
assets.alt: A technical learner holds a phone beside a generic Bitcoin ATM dispensing plain unmarked banknotes. Heading: “Generic Bitcoin ATM”.

assets.title: Comparing Local Payment Options
assets.purpose: Illustrate comparing complete routes and an existing alternative.
assets.alt: the business owner and the older learner examine three equally weighted pictorial cards on desk: cash handover, peer phone exchange, generic computer route. Heading: “Comparing Local Payment Options”.

assets.title: Identity-check Trade-offs
assets.purpose: Show identity verification as one part of a route with privacy responsibilities.
assets.alt: the business owner seated at a laptop holding a generic identity card toward an external camera area, with ID face shown only as simple silhouette and blank rectangles, no readable identity. Heading: “Identity-check Trade-offs”.

assets.title: Circular Local Exchange
assets.purpose: Show a hypothetical circular flow among people exchanging goods and services.
assets.alt: Four adults with teaching materials, shoes, repair tools and produce are connected by a clockwise payment path. Heading: “Circular Local Exchange”.

assets.title: Merchant Accepting Bitcoin
assets.purpose: Illustrate a hypothetical merchant willing to accept Bitcoin.
assets.alt: A merchant stands at a produce stall with a small Bitcoin-symbol sign while a customer holds a phone. Heading: “Merchant Accepting Bitcoin”.

assets.title: Finding and Checking Local Support
assets.purpose: Illustrate discovering and verifying support without treating listings as proof.
assets.alt: the older learner asks the educator and the technical learner for education and technical support at a simple community table with an open guide, a plain contact-card organizer and blank pictorial calendar. Heading: “Finding and Checking Local Support”.

assets.title: Keeping a Local Resource Record
assets.purpose: Show recording useful support and when it was checked.
assets.alt: the business owner writes with pen in a pictorial resource notebook while the educator helps verify a plain contact card. Heading: “Keeping a Local Resource Record”.

assets.title: Choosing a Responsible Next Step
assets.purpose: Illustrate beginning with a need and considering realistic alternatives.
assets.alt: the business owner explains a practical need with a small produce basket; the beginner learner compares two pictorial choices (plain cash and phone) on a tabletop, then points to a small, manageable practice card instead of rushing to pay. Heading: “Choosing a Responsible Next Step”.

assets.title: Community Review Discussion
assets.purpose: Illustrate a voluntary structured review of usefulness and trade-offs.
assets.alt: the older learner explains his own comparison using an open pictorial notebook while the business owner contributes a merchant example with a small goods bag and the educator listens. Heading: “Community Review Discussion”.

assets.title: Learning Network Video Call
assets.purpose: Show informal connection with an education network.
assets.alt: An older learner holds tea during a video call with three fellow educators and learners. Heading: “Learning Network Video Call”.

assets.title: Course Completion and Safety Review
assets.purpose: Support reviewing safety responsibilities at course completion.
assets.alt: A learner reviews a pictorial checklist with a pen beside a phone and a blank symbolic course certificate. Heading: “Course Completion and Safety Review”.

assets.title: Finding Curriculum Updates
assets.purpose: Illustrate accessing maintained learning resources and contributing improvements.
assets.alt: the beginner learner consults an open printed guide while the technical learner checks a laptop facing him, holding a plain correction-note card beside the guide. Heading: “Finding Curriculum Updates”.

assets.title: Voluntary Support for Education
assets.purpose: Illustrate voluntary support for education without payment instructions.
assets.alt: the business owner voluntarily hands a small stack of plain educational notebooks to the educator at a community teaching table; the educator receives them gratefully and calmly. Heading: “Voluntary Support for Education”.

assets.title: Educator-issued Completion Record
assets.purpose: Illustrate an educator explaining a completion record without central verification.
assets.alt: the educator reviews a blank symbolic certificate with the older learner at a desk, pointing to a plain evidence folder beside it. Heading: “Educator-issued Completion Record”.

assets.title: Learning with a Tablet
assets.purpose: Provide general learning-media companion art for an externally supplied image slot.
assets.alt: the older learner actively studies a generic tablet beside an open printed course guide. Heading: “Learning with a Tablet”.

assets.title: From Learner to Community Educator
assets.purpose: Illustrate progressing from learning to helping others in a community.
assets.alt: A gentle connected pair of scenes repeats the beginner learner: on left the beginner learner learns from the educator with open guide; on right the beginner learner explains the same guide to the business owner at a community table while the educator listens. Heading: “From Learner to Community Educator”.

assets.title: Considering a Lightning Payment Request
assets.purpose: Illustrate reviewing a Lightning request while retaining details in guide text.
assets.alt: the business owner shows a generic tablet to the older learner, both look at its screen; viewer sees rear casing only. Heading: “Considering a Lightning Payment Request”.

assets.title: Writing a Private Offline Backup
assets.purpose: Illustrate private careful copying without exposing usable recovery material.
assets.alt: the beginner learner ALONE at a desk privately copies from his own phone to paper with a pen. Heading: “Writing a Private Offline Backup”.

assets.title: Lightning Sender and Receiver
assets.purpose: Illustrate the sender and receiver roles in a Lightning payment.
assets.alt: Two adults hold phones, linked by a directional line with a small Lightning symbol. Heading: “Lightning Sender and Receiver”.

assets.title: Theory and Practical Evidence
assets.purpose: Illustrate explanation and independent practice as distinct evidence activities.
assets.alt: Two equal vignettes: left the older learner explains a pictorial money-choice card to the educator who listens; right the technical learner independently performs a safe arrangement with a blank training phone and pictorial checklist while the educator observes from a distance. Heading: “Theory and Practical Evidence”.

assets.title: Planning Observation Time
assets.purpose: Illustrate matching teaching time and assessor capacity to the cohort.
assets.alt: the educator plans at a desk with an unnumbered wall-clock face, a plain calendar of empty squares, three small seat-layout cards and an open planning notebook. Heading: “Planning Observation Time”.

assets.title: Connecting Tasks and Evidence Records
assets.purpose: Illustrate linking observed actions with criteria and an assessment record.
assets.alt: the technical learner independently arranges a simple task set on table while the educator observes and matches a pictorial criterion card to a plain checklist folder held close to her. Heading: “Connecting Tasks and Evidence Records”.

assets.title: Support without Supplying Answers
assets.purpose: Show access support while preserving independent learner action.
assets.alt: the older learner independently works with a large-print-style pictorial instruction card and empty training phone; the educator places a simple reading stand nearby then steps back, hands away from learner's action. Heading: “Support without Supplying Answers”.

assets.title: Reassessment and Calibration
assets.purpose: Illustrate returning to practice and reviewing evidence consistently.
assets.alt: Two equally sized scenes: the older learner practises again independently with a pictorial task card on left; on right the educator and the technical learner as adult reviewers compare two unlettered evidence sheets against the SAME simple criterion card. Heading: “Reassessment and Calibration”.

assets.title: Teaching Resources and Evidence
assets.purpose: Illustrate distinct resources for teaching planning and recorded evidence.
assets.alt: the educator organizes an open learner guide, a closed educator guide, a laptop facing her with resources and a separate plain evidence folder. Heading: “Teaching Resources and Evidence”.

assets.title: Adapting Teaching While Keeping Standards
assets.purpose: Show varied teaching materials used with a shared standard.
assets.alt: the educator and the business owner compare a printed pictorial simulation and an empty training phone beside one shared plain criterion card in a firm upright stand. Heading: “Adapting Teaching While Keeping Standards”.

assets.title: Educator Teaching Cycle
assets.purpose: Illustrate explaining checking applying and reflecting in a teaching session.
assets.alt: the educator facilitates a small purposeful lesson at a table. Heading: “Educator Teaching Cycle”.

assets.title: Equivalent Accessible Practice Routes
assets.purpose: Illustrate different practice media preserving learner action.
assets.alt: An older learner uses printed pictorial cards while a technical learner uses a phone, with the educator observing both routes. Heading: “Equivalent Accessible Practice Routes”.

assets.title: Stopping Unsafe Practice
assets.purpose: Show stopping protecting and verifying when a safety concern appears.
assets.alt: the educator calmly raises open palm while the beginner learner pauses with finger held away from his phone and places device safely face down. Heading: “Stopping Unsafe Practice”.

assets.title: Private Learner Recovery Work
assets.purpose: Show educator observation without access to secrets.
assets.alt: the older learner works privately behind a small simple upright desk privacy screen with his own device and closed backup envelope; their contents face him only. Heading: “Private Learner Recovery Work”.

assets.title: Understanding Address Linkage
assets.purpose: Illustrate comparing reused and fresh receiving information with fictional pictorial records.
assets.alt: the technical learner and the older learner study two small groups of unlettered teaching records on a table. Heading: “Understanding Address Linkage”.

assets.title: Practice Stations and Observation
assets.purpose: Illustrate teacher support peer practice and independent observation separately.
assets.alt: Three compact classroom stations visible: the educator points to a pictorial guide at first; the older learner compares two printed training cards at second; the technical learner independently uses an empty training phone at third. Heading: “Practice Stations and Observation”.

assets.title: Preparing a Course
assets.purpose: Show planning people materials local checks access safety and evidence before teaching.
assets.alt: the educator and the business owner prepare a teaching table with plain course guides, printed simulation cards, an empty training phone, a small calendar and a reading stand. Heading: “Preparing a Course”.

assets.title: Readiness Before Live Practice
assets.purpose: Show checking readiness and choosing a safer route when a condition is missing.
assets.alt: the educator and the technical learner review a pictorial readiness card beside a training phone that remains face down. Heading: “Readiness Before Live Practice”.

assets.title: Separate Shared-fund Responsibilities
assets.purpose: Show approval key control and record keeping as distinct responsibilities.
assets.alt: Three adults separately handle a key, a payment-proposal card and a record notebook, illustrating distinct shared-fund responsibilities. Heading: “Separate Shared-fund Responsibilities”.

assets.title: Translation Review and Learner Testing
assets.purpose: Illustrate translation as collaborative review followed by learner testing.
assets.alt: the educator and the business owner compare two plain pictorial guide sheets and mark a correction using a pen; the older learner independently tries the pictured task using printed simulation cards and gives thoughtful feedback. Heading: “Translation Review and Learner Testing”.

assets.title: Practice and Formal Assessment
assets.purpose: Illustrate the difference between supported practice and independent evidence.
assets.alt: Two equal scenes repeating the educator/the beginner learner. Heading: “Practice and Formal Assessment”.

assets.title: Verifying Changing Local Claims
assets.purpose: Illustrate checking dated local information before teaching it.
assets.alt: the business owner brings a plain local-information card; the educator cross-checks it with an open source guide and laptop facing her, then pencils a small calendar box on a review note. Heading: “Verifying Changing Local Claims”.

assets.title: Different Control Relationships
assets.purpose: Illustrate comparing similar interfaces with different dependencies.
assets.alt: the educator and the technical learner compare three identical generic phone teaching models on a desk: one paired with equal peer computers; one paired with a generic issuer building and document folder; one paired with a separate developer/service laptop. Heading: “Different Control Relationships”.

assets.title: Reconsidering Changed Conditions
assets.purpose: Show revisiting a decision when one relevant condition changes.
assets.alt: An educator changes a connectivity card from connected to disconnected while a business owner reconsiders her plan. Heading: “Reconsidering Changed Conditions”.
